Chapter One takes place five years later, therefore placing the start of the novel in [[6 BBY]]. The novel ends one [[Standard month|month]] after the [[Battle of Jakku]], which ''Star Wars: Timelines'' dates to [[5 ABY]]. *[[6 BBY]]–[[5 ABY]] |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} {{Quote|It unfolds from the perspective of the rebels, and then the Empire, and then the two characters and their struggles within that context... I found that really interesting.|Yusaka Komiyama|{{SW|url=news/yusaku-komiyama-lost-stars-manga|text=5 Insights from Artist Yusaku Komiyama on Creating the ''Lost Stars'' Manga Adaptation}}}} '''''Lost Stars''''' (in Japanese: ロスト・スターズ) is a [[Wikipedia:Japan|Japanese]] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] by [[Line Corporation]]. An adaptation of [[Claudia Gray]]'s young adult novel ''[[Lost Stars]]'', it is illustrated by [[Yusaku Komiyama]]. The first part of the comic was uploaded on LINE's [http://manga-blog.line.me/ja official blog] on [[May 4]], [[2017]]. The issues were uploaded every two weeks on Thursdays. From chapter 3 onward, were uploaded each first and third Thursday of the month.{{WebCite|url=https://manga.line.me/book/viewer?id=Z0001209&page=9|text=休載のお知らせ | STAR WARS／ロスト・スターズ(＆ TM Lucasfilm Ltd.／小宮山優作) | LINE マンガ|date=2017-06-15|language=Japanese|nobackup=1}} The last chapter was released on [[April 18]], [[2019]]. On [[November 18]], 2017 it was announced by [[Yen Press]] that the manga was going to be officially translated and released in the US. The first volume was released on [[May 8]], [[2018]].{{YenPress|url=9781975326531/star-wars-lost-stars-vol-1-manga|text=Star Wars Lost Stars, Vol. 1 (manga)}} ==Publisher's summary== ''An official Star Wars spin-off! Finally, it has landed in Japan for the first time! The long-awaited manga adaptation of the wildly popular American novel "Lost Stars" (by Claudia Gray), which has not yet been translated into Japanese, has been supervised by Lucasfilm! Two young people, Thane (male) and Ciena (female), who admire the ideals of the Empire, volunteered for the Imperial Army. The two, who have excellent grades and a promising future, are pierced by the truth about the Imperial Army that they had never known before. Another unknown Star Wars story of young people who tried to survive for their own justice during the turbulent times from the rise of the Rebellion to the collapse of the Imperial Army (ep.4-ep.6)!!{{WebCite|url=https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0000104|text=STAR WARS／ロスト・スターズ|language=Japanese|archivedate=20250224001909}}'' ==Media== ===Installments=== {| {{Prettytable}}= ! colspan="3" |Color code key: |- | style="background-color:#FFBB60;" align="center" width="15%" |Collected (TPB) comic | style="background-color:#40CC40;" align="center" width="15%" |Released comic | style="background-color:#FFFF80;" align="center" width="15%" |Future comic |} {| {{Prettytable}}= !Chapter||Publication date|| Trade paperback||Publication date |- | style="background-color:#FFBB60; text-align: center;" |Prologue 1||[[May 4]], [[2017]] | rowspan="13" |

Furthermore, the [[fleet]] depicted in the image is said in the ''[[Lost Stars]]'' novel to be nearly as big as the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron|fleet]] present at the [[Battle of Hoth]]. However, earlier in the same novel, it was said that six [[Star Destroyer]]s were at [[Hoth]]—a significantly smaller force than the one depicted in the image. This was later [[:File:LostStarsMangaSSDFixed.jpg|changed]] in the printed version, the panel now features three ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts. *The thirty-third chapter adapts the fight between [[Ciena Ree]] and [[Thane Kyrell]] aboard the ''[[Inflictor]]''.
